newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's Krakow sells PLN 15 mln muni bonds at par.
newsitem.headline: Poland's Krakow sells PLN 15 mln muni bonds at par.

text.p: The Polish southern city of Krakow sold its entire 15-million zlotys issue of its floating rate five-year bonds at par, the city's treasurer said on Thursday.

Leslaw Fijal told Reuters the annual coupon for the bonds, calculated as a mean average of average yields on 52-week T-bills sold at four auctions prior to the interest period would be 19.52 percent for 1997.
Fijal said a part of the non-public issue was taken up by its co-managers Bank Wspolpracy Regionalnej (BWR), Bank Przemyslowo-Handlowy (BPH) and Bank Pekao SA, which have also underwritten the issue.
The banks would receive a total fee of 0.25 percent of the issue's total value. He did not give any further details.
